title: Reference solution: Stored Routine Security and Privileges practice
answer: Propose a least-privilege role and a credential-safe connection, then explain how you would verify the effective permissions.
explanation: Propose a least-privilege role and a credential-safe connection, then explain how you would verify the effective permissions. This answer favors a controlled example, an explicit expected result, and verification. The alternatives that skip tests, broaden permissions, concatenate untrusted input, or assume identical dialect behavior are unsafe or insufficient.
